steps.content: Soon after you've set off on your escape, the motorbike's vroom is catching up.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Tsk, Iron said she'd buy us time, this is honestly not a lot of time.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It means our pursuer is very strong.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Her motorbike looks the same as the ones from the Legion fleet that attacked the Public Security Bureau.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What rotten luck, I'm pretty sure they're here to kill you again.

options: Does that mean the doctor has already...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ted has said SALVA and the Legion get along with each other. This mercenary won't go as far as killing their boss's friend... I suppose.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You don't have time to worry about others. Hey blondie! Go faster! Are you driving a tractor?
You hear a motorbike's screeching vroom, meaning the pursuer is very close to you now.
Her huge sword is trailing on the ground, dragging out shiny sparks, an even more nerve-racking sight than the blinding white headlights.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: The enemy is strong. We've already worn ourselves out in SALVA, we can only avoid fighting her now.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Keep our distance.

steps.speaker: Driver
steps.content: You guys are not Syndicans, right... Civil servants?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: How the hell is that your business? Stop probing, you little punk, keep driving and...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...look ahead?!
The driver slams on the brakes. The road is blocked.
In front of you, a large crowd of gangsters is fleeing and rushing in your direction. They all look terrified and panicky.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh no, oh no, I've seen this before... We've run into a fresh round of gang fights. That's a wave of fleeing losers.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What bad luck, they just have to get in our way right now.

steps.speaker: Gangster
steps.content: Holy ****! A car! Take it!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hella, calm down, get off the car and deal with it.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Clean up some obstacles before the pursuer catches up with us. The worst-case scenario is facing attacks from both sides.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I know!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, watch the blondie, don't let him get away. We'll need someone to dri... Where is he?!
The blond driver has already opened the door on the other side and escaped.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Forget about him. We'll pick someone from the gang who can drive later. Now get ready to fight!
